variants.before: Published synchronous coalescer, serial fetch/handle/commit, fixed 1 ms sleep per flush
variants.after: One-batch read-ahead, 1 ms collection measured from oldest queued request
variants.window2: Selected implementation: one-batch read-ahead, 2 ms collection measured from oldest queued request

environment.logs: Written inside container; copied to host after each test binary exits

method.baseline_test_overlay: All variants use the same extended comparison tests, including durable completion. Final duplicate-bound assertions, longer race-test deadlines and the RUN_COOPERATIVE_THROUGHPUT opt-in for the large diagnostic were added afterward; runtime behavior is identical.

workloads.EagerComparison: 960 records; second member joins after partition 0 delivers 16

limitations: Small local backlogs, not production steady-state capacity
Host load varied; eager controls and per-run ranges are included
Commit policies differ: eager interval asynchronous, cooperative synchronous per batch
Metadata payload bytes exclude record headers, replication traffic and compaction
Fetched payload includes discarded read-ahead; handler replay bytes count duplicate handler records only
Do not compare absolute rates against older runs as if host conditions were identical
